name: Mid-handoff duplicate doorbell resilience
goal: A mid-handoff duplicate doorbell must not cause duplicate outbox files or duplicate imported messages for the same latest state.

# Mid-Handoff Duplicate Doorbell

This scenario forces a non-terminal handoff before final. Duplicate doorbells may fire while the next agent is active.

context: You are testing duplicate-doorbell resilience under v2. A duplicate doorbell may fire for the same latest state while a peer turn is active. Required flow: Claude writes exactly one continue outbox to Codex instructing Codex to write exactly one continue confirmation and then stop. Codex must write exactly one continue confirmation and must not write additional outboxes unless a new user injection arrives. Claude must write the only final outbox after Codex's confirmation. Additional ping-pong continue messages are scenario failures. The final answer must mention mid-handoff duplicate doorbell resilience.
